limits: All combined ROI triangles are checked; geometry outside exported ROI is not covered.
Proper crossings and positive-area coplanar overlaps exclude source/seam-adjacent triangles. Mere touching is not counted as penetration.
Area/edge ratios use actual rendered neutral; same-twist neutral is an additional diagnostic.
75degree poses are stress cases, never folded into60degree acceptance.
Visual acceptance and whole-action/whole-body collisions remain separate.

measuredAngles.method: Independent neutral-relative forearm-to-hand matrix; signed longitudinal swing and axial quaternion twist. Command values are not used.

seamNormals.method: Normalize actual render-time world normals independently; acos of corresponding seam-pair dot products.

rigidHandAndDb.method: Fit one proper rigid transform to protected hand cloud; use same transform to predict all DB points. No fit to DB points.
